transcript.message: Hi, we're interested in the T45 Utility with the front loader for a 19-acre property: brush hogging, gravel work, and tilling. List would be $48,500 for the package. We're ready to buy quickly. Would you do $40,000 for the T45 with loader?

Thanks for reaching out. The T45 with the loader is a strong fit for 19 acres. The 45 hp and Cat I/II 3-point hitch will handle a brush hog and tiller well, and the 540 PTO runs standard implements. The quick-attach 60-inch bucket makes gravel work much faster. $40,000 is too far below the package for me to accept. Since you're ready to move quickly, I can do $47,000 for the T45 with the front loader.
Thanks for coming down. $47,000 is still above where we can go for the package. We're ready to close this week. I can move to $42,000 for the T45 with the front loader.

I appreciate you moving up, and I'd like to get this done this week too. I can come down to $46,000 for the T45 Utility with the front loader. You get a machine that's sized right for brush hogging, gravel, and tilling on 19 acres, and you can be working with it right away.
We're getting closer. To close this week, I can go to $43,000 for the T45 Utility with the front loader. That's a solid package and we're ready to sign now.

Thanks for meeting me partway. Here's what I can do to close this week: $45,500 for the T45 Utility with the front loader, and I'll include delivery and setup within 150 miles. We'll bring it to your property, set it up, and walk you through it on site, so you're brush hogging and moving gravel from day one.

Delivery and setup is a welcome addition, thank you. We're still a bit apart on price, though. I can go to $44,000 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and delivery/setup included. If that works, we can sign today and schedule delivery right away.

We're close, and I want to get you signed today. I'll meet you at $45,000 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and delivery and setup included. If that works, we can sign today and get delivery scheduled.

We're very close. Let's split the difference and call it done: $44,300 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and delivery/setup included. That's my final number, and we'll sign today and get delivery on the calendar.

You've got a deal at $44,300 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and delivery and setup included. Let's get the paperwork signed today, and we'll put delivery on the calendar right away. Thanks for working with us, and I think you'll be very happy with this machine on your 19 acres.
